mcq.q: A ticket was created but the response was lost. A safe retry needs…
mcq.why: The server returns the stored result for a repeated key instead of creating a duplicate.

mcq.q: Where are step and cost limits enforced?
mcq.why: Prompts can be ignored; the runtime must stop the loop.

mcq.q: An approved email is edited by the agent afterwards. What should happen?
mcq.why: An approval applies to one exact version of the action.
